channel.title: BBC Good Food - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from BBC Good Food (bbcgoodfood.com)

item.title: Nduja, fennel & seafood en papillote with cheat's aioli
item.description: Fancy something lighter for Sunday lunch? This seafood bake is a flavourful alternative to a roasting joint. Serve with crusty bread to mop up the juices

item.title: Onion bhaji chicken tenders
item.description: Rustle up our crisp and spicy chicken strips. They are super-versatile – use them to fill naan wraps, burger buns, or include in a curry-themed spread of small plates

item.title: Spiced baked feta with bean ragu & walnuts
item.description: Try baked feta nestled in a butter bean and tomato ragu for an easy meal for two. Scatter over walnuts and a drizzle of honey to serve plus crusty bread

item.title: Yogurt sauce
item.description: Combine Greek yogurt with mango chutney and ground cumin to make this fruity, spicy yogurt. Enjoy with our onion bhaji chicken tenders or in sandwiches

item.title: Crunchy slaw
item.description: Serve this crunchy slaw with our onion bhaji chicken tenders or your favourite grilled meats. It also works well in burgers, sandwiches, jacket potatoes and salads

item.title: Pork loin roast with caramelised onion & garlic potatoes
item.description: Save on washing-up with this one-pot roast. Similar in flavour to the French potato dish pommes boulangère, the meat, potatoes and gravy all cook in one pan

item.title: Air fryer keema samosas
item.description: Enjoy these keema samosas made with lamb or beef mince. They make a great dish to mark Eid, the Festival of Breaking the Fast following Ramadan

item.title: Chilli pakora
item.description: A delicious vegan snack, these pakora deliver crunch and a mild spicy flavour — they’re made with padron peppers but you can use hotter chillies if you prefer

item.title: Tandoori-style lamb chops
item.description: Enjoy these Tandoori-inspired lamb chops with warm naans and chutney. It's a perfect meal to mark Eid, the Festival of Breaking the Fast following Ramadan

item.title: Best vitamin D supplements 2026, tried and tested
item.description: In the UK we’re advised to take vitamin D during the winter months, as we mainly source it from sunlight. Read our review to discover the different types of supplements you can take, and the best brands to choose
